name: backdrop-freeze
description: What stops an animated backdrop in the Claude desktop app: a mod that reproduces it, and the mod it was found in.

plugins.name: backdrop-freeze-repro
plugins.description: Shows a small animated backdrop in the desktop app with or without one thing that stops its CSS animation. /freeze-repro ok moves, /freeze-repro class stands still.

plugins.name: clone-wars
plugins.description: Three animated pixel-art backdrops for the desktop app: a space battle, the Claude mascot asleep until a firework goes off, and a process plant that runs while Claude works. /clone-wars battle, fireworks or plant.
